scope: 保留r01真实失败；r02按固定操作包204/205建立会话内双核停止，无复位/PL/非易失存储操作。

events.name: continue_inventory
events.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
[Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$debug=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(hw_server|cs_server|xsdb|xsct|vivado|vitis)\.exe$' -or ($_.Name -ceq 'pwsh.exe' -and $_.ProcessId -ne $PID -and $_.CommandLine -match '-File.*capture_uart\.ps1') } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine,@{Name='CreationTimeFileTimeUtc';Expression={[string]$_.CreationDate.ToFileTimeUtc()}})
$ports=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_SerialPort | Select-Object DeviceID,Name,PNPDeviceID,Status)
$listeners=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3121 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess)
[pscustomobject]@{checked_at_utc8=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToOffset([TimeSpan]::FromHours(8)).ToString('o');debug_processes=$debug;serial_ports=$ports;listeners=$listeners} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6

events.name: capture_start_parse_only
events.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$text=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false,$true).GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$tokens=$null
$parseErrors=$null
$ast=[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput($text,[ref]$tokens,[ref]$parseErrors)
if ($parseErrors.Count -gt 0) { $parseErrors | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; throw '启动命令语法错误，未执行' }
[pscustomobject]@{status='PARSE_ONLY_OK';executed=$false;error_count=$parseErrors.Count;extent_length=$ast.Extent.Text.Length;time_utc8=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToOffset([TimeSpan]::FromHours(8)).ToString('o')} | ConvertTo-Json

events.name: capture_stop
events.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$runItem=Get-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\22061\.codex\worktrees\96a3\FPGA_Competition\report\evidence\S2B-T06\ps_jtag_retry_20261009_120653_r01'
$identityPath=Join-Path $runItem.FullName 'uart_capture_identity.json'
$identity=Get-Content -LiteralPath $identityPath -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$captureProcess=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ("ProcessId="+$identity.pid)
if ($null -eq $captureProcess -or [string]$captureProcess.CreationDate.ToFileTimeUtc() -cne $identity.creation_time_filetime_utc -or $captureProcess.ExecutablePath -cne $identity.executable_path -or $captureProcess.CommandLine -cne $identity.command_line) { throw '采集进程身份变化，拒绝操作' }
$stopPath=$identity.stop_flag
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stopPath) { throw '停止标志已存在，拒绝覆盖' }
$stopStream=[IO.File]::Open($stopPath,[IO.FileMode]::CreateNew,[IO.FileAccess]::Write,[IO.FileShare]::Read)
try { $stopBytes=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false).GetBytes('本次下载前双核停止门禁失败，未初始化；保留空串口原始证据并正常关闭采集。'+[Environment]::NewLine); $stopStream.Write($stopBytes,0,$stopBytes.Length); $stopStream.Flush() } finally { $stopStream.Dispose() }
$process=Get-Process -Id $identity.pid
if (-not $process.WaitForExit(10000)) { throw '采集进程没有在10秒内退出，保留日志待诊断' }
$raw=Get-Item -LiteralPath $identity.raw_path
$stdoutPath=Join-Path $runItem.FullName 'uart_capture_stdout.log'
$stdout=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($stdoutPath,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false,$true))
if (-not $stdout.Contains('CAPTURE_CLOSED ')) { throw '退出后没有关闭记录' }
[pscustomobject]@{status='CAPTURE_CLOSED_OBSERVED';pid=$identity.pid;stop_flag=$stopPath;raw_bytes=$raw.Length;raw_sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $raw.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant();stdout=$stdout;observed_at_utc8=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToOffset([TimeSpan]::FromHours(8)).ToString('o');process_exit_code=$process.ExitCode} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,datetime
root=Path.cwd();parent=root/'report/evidence/S2B-T06';assert parent.is_dir()
old=parent/'ps_jtag_retry_20261009_120653_r01';assert old.is_dir()
for name,sha,target in [('review_receipt.json','b0be795349bf59f0ffb24b090df15b4220ec7b72d2b2fc9bb01f9cbc667f4f11d','ps_runner_initial_review_receipt.json'),('review_receipt_r02.json','7a22431108dd3a8e181ed73646359eea506a8813f1c7a50bebb78b775a7061b0','ps_runner_review_receipt.json')]:

 if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=sha:print('RECEIPT_NOT_COPIED_SHA_MISMATCH',name,hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest());continue
 with (old/target).open('xb') as f:f.write(data)
